@graph.name: Superhero Santa: Christ-Centered Christmas Books for Toddlers
@graph.description: A toddler bedtime picture-book series where Santa is the helper and Christmas has a hero. Book One, “Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing!”, is coming soon.

@graph.name: Superhero Santa
@graph.description: Christmas picture books in which Santa is brave, kind and a little bit super, but not the point: every adventure ends where Christmas begins, with a family, a bright star and the birth of Jesus. The series begins with a toddler bedtime reader; a full-edition picture book and a children’s book are to follow, with a novel series for teens in development.

@graph.name: Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing!
@graph.description: Book One of the Superhero Santa series: a toddler bedtime reader for ages 1 to 3. After the presents have been delivered and the New Year has rung in, the eight sleigh Reindeer vanish. Santa, Mrs. Claus and the elves follow a long, snowy trail, and the story ends where Christmas begins: with a family and a bright star witnessing the birth of Jesus. Short lines and big pictures, made to read aloud. Coming soon in print and ebook.
